The indicators point in the same direction: the planet is warmer and the atmosphere contains more greenhouse gases. In the latest available value, global temperature reached +1.19 °C relative to the 1951–1980 average and CO₂ reached 424.6 ppm. Since 1993, global mean sea level has risen by about 102 mm; in the selection shown, the Arctic sea-ice minimum declined by 33.3%.
